name: Pipeliners - Avondale Keyword Research 2026-10-10
body:
> Research · Pipeliners · 2026-10-10

# Summary
Keyword research and page copy for the /avondale/ rebuild (Oct 10, 2026). This is the reference rebuild that later "restructure" and "rebuild" work on other city pages copies. Sources: GSC Domain property for the page (Jul 11 to Oct 8, 73 queries), Search Atlas keyword research (projects 5108216 and 5108229), Site Explorer 233578 and rank tracker 34164 (no Avondale data in either).

# Key findings
- Page performance (90 days): 709 impressions, 1 click, average position 31.1. Avondale-named queries: 486 impressions at 22.4, all on this page.
- Demand split: sewer and trenchless about 294 impressions, repipe and galvanized about 131 (existing wording only), water line about 43 (ePIPE), gas about 15 (not offered).
- Search Atlas has no Avondale-level volume; local demand comes from GSC. Parent "trenchless sewer repair" 4,400 a month US, KD 15, transactional.
- Primary keyword kept: "trenchless sewer repair in Avondale, AZ" (aligned since Sep 19; variants rank 9 to 14; same pattern as sister city pages).
- Cannibalization: nothing else competes for Avondale intent (/hydro-jetting/ 4 impressions, GBP 3). Generic terms belong to other pages: CIPP to /what-is-cipp/, "pipe lining" spread over 15+ URLs (avoid; also against house style).
- Keywords to add: no-dig sewer repair, sewer line replacement without digging, sewer lining or relining, camera inspection, problem-led terms (tree roots, cast iron, clay, belly), and Avondale's verified "who pays for what" sewer rule (City Code 24-91 and 24-92).
- Keep the existing repipe and galvanized FAQ wording exactly as it is.

# Decisions and status
- Copy went through three versions: a first draft, a simpler v2 for homeowners, and v3 "as built" in the WordPress draft on Oct 10 (title, meta and H1 unchanged). Word versions of the copy were made for Drive.
- Per the scorecard, Avondale was rebuilt Oct 10.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `Avondale-Keyword-Research-2026-10-10.md`: the research report.
- `Avondale-Page-Copy-Draft-2026-10-10.md`, `...-v2-simple-...md`, `...-v3-as-built-...md`: copy versions; `Avondale-Page-Copy-2026-10-10.docx` and `-v3.docx`: Word versions.
- `gsc-avondale-queries-2026-07-11_to_2026-10-08.csv`: raw GSC export. `live/` HTML and `extract.py` not summarized.
